info.title: Vault API
info.description: Document storage, workspaces and revocable share links. JSON over HTTPS with a session cookie. Every error has the shape { error: { code, message } }. The same routes are served under /api/v1.

apiToken.description: A personal API token (vlt_...) from /api/auth/tokens. A read token may only make GET requests. Account security routes need a session.

emailVerified.description: False until the address is confirmed; share links and invitations need it.

prefix.description: The first characters of the token, to tell tokens apart.

name.description: What the token is for, e.g. "backup script".

scopes.description: read: GET requests only. write: everything the account can do (write includes read).

inviteUrl.description: Only when EXPOSE_INVITE_LINKS is enabled (development). The email is sent by the worker.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes; null only while an older file is backfilled.

scanStatus.description: pending: being checked for malware (not downloadable yet). infected: removed. unscanned: not scanned (scanning off, too large, or uploaded before scanning).

starred.description: Whether you starred it. Present in listings.

version.description: The current version; earlier ones are in /versions.

thumbnail.description: GET /api/documents/{id}/thumbnail has a picture of it.

previewable.description: GET /api/documents/{id}/preview can show it (PDFs, images, and converted Office files).

matchSnippet.description: When searching and the text matched: a passage around the match, with the matched terms in ⟦ ⟧.

links.description: Rollup of live share links. Present in listings.

counts.description: Tab counts for the whole workspace; null on pages after the first.

duplicateOf.description: A live document in the workspace with identical content.

folderId.description: null moves the document to the workspace root.

action.description: delete permanently removes documents already in the trash (owners only).

folderId.description: Where move puts them; null is the workspace root.

skipped.description: Chosen files left out because the malware scan has not cleared them.

filename.description: The name the document had when this version was current.

distinctViewers.description: Estimate: NAT merges viewers, network changes split them.

partSize.description: Every part except the last is exactly this many bytes.

url.description: PUT the part body here. Read the ETag response header.

expiresInHours.description: null = never expires; omitted = the default (create) or unchanged (edit).

allowDownload.description: false = view only: the file is shown in the page (watermarked) and cannot be downloaded. PDFs and images only.

allowedEmails.description: Only these people can open the link, each proving their address with a one-time emailed code. Empty = anyone with the link.

watermark.description: On a view-only link: the text stamped on the file, to overlay on images.

path.description: From the shared folder down to the one shown.

truncated.description: More than 500 folders or files here; only the first are listed.

legacyEvents.description: Events recorded before hashing began; not verifiable.

head.description: The last verified event. Record its hash elsewhere to detect later removal from the end.

digest.description: A summary email of unread notifications.

instant.description: Types also emailed as they happen.

muted.description: Types not shown in the app (still emailed if also in instant). Essential types cannot be muted.
